newsitem.title: CROATIA: Croatian interbank rates steady, trade lively.
newsitem.headline: Croatian interbank rates steady, trade lively.

text.p: Croatian interbank rates remained steady to slightly higher amid exceptionally high liquidity in Friday morning's money market trade, dealers said.
"The market has seen extremely lively trade this morning," a dealer said.
She said the morning was characterised by a large surplus on the supply side of some 15 million kuna ($2.5 million), as bank repaid loans taken earlier.
Fresh loans were put at 28.3 million kuna, of which 14 million were call money loans granted at 10.5 and 12 percent, the latter being a loan to a savings bank.
The rest were several smaller loans granted at between 12 and 16 percent.
Thursday's overnight trade was 3.5 million kuna as one bank sought funds to maintain its mandatory reserve. -- Sandra Kalogjera, Zagreb Newsroom, 385-1-4557075 ($ = 5.983 Croatian Kuna)
